text: The company says: pay it all, or we cut you off.
But the Electricity Act requires fifteen clear days' written notice first.
Disputing the bill? Deposit, under protest, the lower amount: what they claim, or your six-month average for each month.
Then they can't cut you off while the dispute is pending.
So put your dispute in writing, pay the lower amount, and keep the receipt.
